title: Fundamental lemma of the calculus of variations on a set of positive local measure (parent step 7c)
statement: Vanishing from zero weighted integrals. Data: P ∈ ℕ; a (Borel) measure μ on ℝ^P; U, M ⊆ ℝ^P; h : ℝ^P → ℝ. Hypotheses: U is open; M ⊆ U; M is measurable; h is continuous on M; μ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U; μ(M ∩ B_s(x)) > 0 for every x ∈ M and every s > 0 (B_s(x) the open ball); and ∫_M φ·h dμ = 0 for every C^∞ function φ : ℝ^P → ℝ with compact support and tsupport φ ⊆ U. Conclusion: h(x) = 0 for every x ∈ M.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (h : Euclid P → ℝ), IsOpen U → M ⊆ U → MeasurableSet M → ContinuousOn h M → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ x ∈ M, ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → 0 < μ (M ∩ ball x s)) → (∀ φ : Euclid P → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in M, φ x * h x ∂μ = 0) → ∀ x ∈ M, h x = 0
